candidate.title: BrdU-CLIP
candidate.scope: The single BrdU-CLIP workflow in the assigned Illumina schematic, also captioned “A schematic overview of BrdU-CLIP” on the verified collection page. It follows an RNA–protein complex through crosslinking, RNA 3′-adapter addition, protein-directed immunoprecipitation, proteinase K treatment, BrdU-containing RT cDNA, circularization, and the combined affinity-purification/linearization/PCR block to a cDNA library. The left “iCLIP with BrdU affinity purification (BrdU-CLIP)” emblem is descriptive of this target, not a separate alternative route. The primary-paper implementation resolves the primer, DNA-label selection and recovery of both cDNA classes; the local graph preserves the illustrated truncated route and the displayed adapter-before-IP order. This is a schematic architecture rather than a complete execution protocol or a claim that all iCLIP/HITS-CLIP implementations share these steps.
